title: AI Model from Anthropic Helps Prove 18-Year-Old Quantum Computing Conjecture
summary: Anthropic AI model helps prove 18-year-old quantum computing conjecture
detailed: Physical Superintelligence Inc. (PSI) used an unpublished Anthropic AI model to prove the 18-year-old Aaronson-Ambainis quantum computing conjecture in three days.
The proof demonstrates that specific exponential speed advantages of quantum computers require special patterns or structures, confirming long-suspected limits.
The research system was developed by PSI technical team member David Turturean.
This matters because it resolves a fundamental question in quantum information science regarding when quantum computers significantly outperform conventional ones.
